data.one_liner: Heatmap widget for Flutter with customizable colors and dynamic labels
data.what_it_does: Provides a grid of colored cells representing data values. Supports custom color palettes, rounded corners, and click callbacks to retrieve cell data. Allows limiting visible rows and expanding to show all.
use_when: You need a visual heatmap for data like consumption or usage
You want to customize colors and cell styles
You need to handle cell taps to show details
avoid_when: You need a chart with axes and legends
You require complex animations beyond simple color changes
strengths: Easy to integrate, no code generation required
Supports dynamic labels and custom color palettes
weaknesses: No built‑in animations or advanced chart features
Limited to rectangular heatmaps, not line/bar charts
data.setup_notes: Add dependency and run flutter packages get
